text: Gardening is a rewarding hobby that enhances one's living space and offers a connection to the natural world. At the heart of every successful garden is a rich soil foundation, achieved through the careful preparation of compost. Compost transforms organic waste into a nutrient-rich soil amendment, enhancing plant growth and reducing the need for synthetic fertilizers. Once the soil is prepared, it is covered with a layer of mulch to conserve moisture, regulate soil temperature, and suppress weeds, ensuring the garden thrives. As gardeners continue to nurture their green spaces, they also add to this protective layer with mulch, further optimizing soil health and preventing erosion.
